Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you. In short:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?

- **Scheduling, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
